Topics covered in this PDF

BSOC-108 (Economic Sociology) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Society, culture and economy, reciprocity and gift, hunting and gathering societies, pastoral economies, domestic mode of production
  • Formalism and Substantivism, socialism, the Washington Consensus, social development, new economic sociology

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three sections, answer all the questions, total marks 100
  • Section I: questions 1 and 2, about 500 words each, 20 marks each
  • Section II: questions 3 to 5, about 250 words each, 10 marks each
  • Section III: questions 6 to 10, about 100 words each, 6 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
